title: feat(jaspic): prepare Gmail send-only consent offline
purpose: 通知・メール配信とその運用に関する変更／認証・アクセス制御に関する変更／画面表示や操作に関する変更

body: Prepare a separate Gmail `gmail.send` consent URL with PKCE and state, without wiring it to production routes. Existing identity-only OAuth remains unchanged. No token exchange, storage, Gmail API calls, mail sending, cron, or merge of migration PR #155. Follow-up requires admin-bound callback, token protection, explicit permission review and dry-run checks.
